cases.input: One process family has two concurrently valid variants.
cases.expect: Separate instances pin their chosen immutable variant and version.

cases.input: A step executes manually out of planned sequence.
cases.expect: The trace records a deviation and any compensating execution without rewriting history.

cases.input: A revised procedure is published and later adopted.
cases.expect: Only work after the adopter's effective date uses the new edition.

cases.input: A BPMN path is treated as proof that those steps occurred.
cases.expect: The conformance claim is rejected without observed execution evidence.

cases.input: An absent event is interpreted as a conforming skipped step.
cases.expect: The inference is rejected; missing evidence remains missing.
